fusions.name: Fine Weave
fusions.desc: Whips a thread-fine link at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 8 damage, up to 1.6 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 8 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Combed Strands
fusions.desc: Looses 6 fine strands in a fan out to 5 tiles, each dealing 2 damage.

fusions.name: Woven Mantle
fusions.desc: Weaves a mantle of fine links around you that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbs in the Weave
fusions.desc: Against an enemy that carries an affliction, your damage rises by 12%.
